description: This file defines a Python class 'RunnerPlugin' that provides mechanisms to load, validate, and instantiate test runner classes for the 'behave' testing framework. It includes methods for handling runner class names, aliases, and configuration integration, as well as error handling for invalid classes.

classes.name: RunnerPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for loading, validating, and creating test runner instances based on class names, aliases, or class objects within the 'behave' testing framework.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RunnerPlugin with optional runner name, class, and aliases.

methods.name: is_class_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given class is a valid test runner class implementing the 'ITestRunner' interface and having a callable 'run' method.

methods.name: validate_class
methods.description: Validates that a class supports the required 'ITestRunner' interface and attributes, raising errors if not.

methods.name: load_class
methods.description: Loads a runner class from a scoped class name string, performing validation and error handling.

methods.name: make_problem_description
methods.description: Checks a runner class for issues and returns a description or empty string if none.

methods.name: make_runner
methods.description: Creates an instance of a runner class based on configuration, class name, or alias, with error handling.
